study type: Case-control study with in vitro functional assays
cohort: The study included 25 women with preeclampsia and 20 normal pregnant women from whom placenta tissues were collected.
finding: miR-30a-3p was significantly increased in the placentas of women with preeclampsia, and its overexpression suppressed IGF-1 protein expression, altered trophoblast invasive capacity, and induced trophoblast apoptosis in cell lines.
